stem: What is a belief people have about using traditional recipes in the selection "Tradition with a Twist" that is NOT described in the article "Cultural Cooking Connections"?

options.label: A
options.text: People believe traditional recipes should only come from family members.

options.label: B
options.text: Some people think traditional recipes should be used in expensive restaurants.

options.label: C
options.text: Some people feel upset when traditional recipes are changed.

options.label: D
options.text: People believe that certain traditional recipes make the food taste different.
